notes: Colour truth comes only from target_prompt.txt and appearance.json; scene metadata and material names are not colour authority.
All semantic roots are retained for DF. Shared-colour entities are grouped in one attribute, fixed across all nine cells.
T1: target warm ivory -> white; AC chestnut brown -> brown.
T2: target chestnut brown -> brown; AC slate blue -> blue.
T3: target slate blue -> blue; AC warm ivory -> white.
Outer-ring alternation and inner-ring colours are represented by fixed per-horse bindings from appearance.json, not the numeric parity of non-contiguous object IDs.
